Attached: 1 video

Where do AI agents actually fit in a medallion lakehouse?

I mapped an Azure stack: on-prem Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Excel and docs → Data Factory → Bronze/Silver/Gold on ADLS + Snowflake → Databricks, with Purview and Unity Catalog governing every layer.

Then I pinned 6 agents where they help: documents, pipeline ops, schema drift, data quality, analytics and governance.

Agents propose, people approve.

Which would you build first?

#DataEngineering #AIAgents #Lakehouse
